entities.name: Pedro Alonso Niño
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Alonso Niño was known in his time as Peralonso Niño, he was a Spanish navigator and discoverer. He piloted the Santa María during Christopher Columbus's first voyage to the Americas in 1492, and accompanied him on his second voyage in 1493.
